Indie Bread — bakery logo identity (2019).

A monochrome logo exploration for an independent bakery, working the obvious symbols honestly: a bread-slice badge, a loaf, a stone oven, a sheaf of wheat. Black on white throughout, so the mark stamps cleanly onto a paper bag or a loaf tag.

Logo identity — Anirudh Kapoor. A·66.
